story.title: What If a Lion Had a Turtle Shell in the Deep Ocean?
story.signature_move: It uses its thick, padded paws to silently stalk the siphonophore before pulling it beneath its heavy dome shell.
story.hybrid_look: Its heavy, muscular big-cat body with tawny fur mixed with a scale texture prowls with slow, heavy confidence, featuring a turtle-shaped head, the lion's eyes, thick padded paws, a dome shell, and a long tail ending in a dark tuft.
